clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, the search for Velinde Starsong brings strangers to the Carevin family. Clerk Daltry points them to the hunters after hearing of wolf-men in Ashenvale.

The search for Velinde Starsong leads from Kalimdor’s ancient forests to Duskwood. In Darkshire, clerk Daltry finds no town record of an elven priestess staying there. But mention the savage wolf-men seen in Ashenvale, and he listens closely. Beasts like those have begun terrorizing the woods around town.

The Carevin family hunts the horrors that trouble Duskwood. Known locally for tracking demons, undead, and other monsters, the family has already faced the wolf-men. Their tracker, Calor, recently hauled a grisly string of severed wolf-men heads through Darkshire’s streets. Clerk Daltry sends you to Jonathan Carevin, the stern head of the household, to learn what the hunters know about the worgen.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: No, I don't have any records of a Velinde Starsong staying in Darkshire... Though, if you don't mind me saying, I can hardly imagine a night elf priestess taking a room in the inn, if you get my meaning?

These wolf-men you mentioned though, that's something I've heard about. Just the other day, Calor came into town with a string of their heads. He works with the Carevin family. Hunters of demons, undead, and other monstrosities. Speak with Jonathan, he's the head of the household.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dark times these are. Ill news is whispered from every swaying branch, and evil can be found under every rock.
And in such times an unknown stranger enters my home and asks of worgen... I'll ask no forgiveness for my suspicions, only answers.
